column1: # shell-lint baseline — the WHOLE measurement this repo gates on, regenerated by
# "bin/shell-lint.sh --update-baseline". Hand edits are pointless: the next run of that
# command overwrites them. WHAT THIS IS: a debt ledger of findings that existed when the
# lane landed, so the lane starts green and reds on the NEXT one. Nothing here has been
# judged correct. Read the header of bin/shell-lint.sh for why it is keyed by count and
# not by line, and for what a FALLING count does and does not prove.
# A COUNT IS A FUNCTION OF THREE INPUTS, and all three are recorded here BECAUSE A CHANGE
# TO ANY OF THEM MOVES EVERY COUNT while nothing in the code moved:
#   "#cfg"  the analyser version, the exact invocation, the codes that analyser actually
#           emits over a fixed probe script, and every "# shellcheck" directive inside a
#           population file. A .shellcheckrc, a SHELLCHECK_OPTS, a file-scope disable or
#           a severity floor each drive counts to zero exactly as a fix does, and this
#           block is the only record that tells those apart.
#   "#pop"  the file population the counts were measured over.
# bin/shell-lint.sh re-derives all of it on every run and REFUSES to report on a tree that
# measures less than this file records. Narrowing it takes a typed --accept-shrink, the
# same way adding debt to it takes a typed --accept-new.
